subject: Prompt-set acceptance & A/B rollout — action plan
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <apark@atlasai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Prompt-set acceptance & A/B rollout — action plan

Team — looping you in on the Atlas AI prompt-set rollout. Goal: agree on acceptance criteria and the A/B/canary rollout plan so we can schedule the production cutoff. Key asks by area below. I attached an initial acceptance matrix and the promptset CSV for quick reference.

Ask (product): define the primary user-facing quality metric and the minimum delta we will accept (suggest: ~0.8% absolute improvement on Atlas NLU score or no degradation >0.5% on safety markers).
Ask (research): produce a 1k-example holdout run (split by vertical) and surface false-positive/false-negative buckets; include a short set of golden prompts for manual review.
Ask (infra/platform): confirm canary traffic % and fallback policy; we should define automated rollback triggers (latency p95 increase, error spike, quality delta threshold).

Proposed rollout windows:
- Canary A: 5% traffic for 48 hours with continuous monitoring
- Ramp to 25% for 24 hours if no failures
- Ramp to 100% after 72h stable
Owners (proposed):
- Product: Marissa (acceptance sign-off)
- Research: Rishi (eval harness & analysis)
- Platform: Karthik + Dev (canary config + alerts)
Action items: please reply with concrete thresholds/changes by EOD Wednesday so I can lock the rollout timeline with Atlas procurement.
Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Product Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments: acceptance_matrix_v1.xlsx, promptset_v2.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <apark@atlasai.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Prompt-set acceptance & A/B rollout — action plan

Thanks Priya — good framing. Quick notes from product side: 
- Primary metric: Atlas NLU composite (precision-weighted). Secondary: end-to-end completion satisfaction (CSAT samples).
- Acceptance threshold: require no regression >0.5% on safety markers; for the primary metric, we need >=0.6% uplift in the top usage bucket OR no regression and parity on latency/cost.
- Add token-cost-neutrality gate: if cost/token increases >3% we require exec approval.
I attached a short PDF with representative regression examples from prior rollouts (regression_examples.pdf) — helps us calibrate human review.
I'll take product sign-off if research + infra confirm evaluation method and the canary alert thresholds.
— Marissa
Senior PM, Evals & Model Quality | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <apark@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Prompt-set acceptance & A/B rollout — action plan

Noted. From platform/infra perspective:
- Canary traffic: 5% sounds reasonable. We'll run the canary on a dedicated pool to avoid noisy neighbors. If Atlas has sustained peak load patterns we should reserve burst capacity for the 48h window.
- Rollback triggers (proposed concrete thresholds):
  * Latency: p95 > baseline p95 + 200ms for >15m window
  * Errors: 5xx spikes > 0.8% of requests over 10m
  * Quality: automated eval delta worse than -0.5% on primary metric over 1k sample slide
- Alerting: create an automated PagerDuty alert for infra on any rollback trigger; create an Ops Slack channel #atlas-canary.

I'll need a dry-run with the KV-cache warming (we'll simulate prefix caching) — Dev and I can run this on Wed morning if Rishi can provide the sample bundle by EOD Tue.

Karthik
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Prompt-set acceptance & A/B rollout — action plan

On Tue, Jun 23, 2026 at 09:30 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> 
> I'll need a dry-run with the KV-cache warming (we'll simulate prefix caching) — Dev and I can run this on Wed morning if Rishi can provide the sample bundle by EOD Tue.
Agree with the proposed gates. A few research specifics: 
- I'll produce a 1k holdout (stratified by vertical and prompt-length) and run both automated evals + a 150-example human review pool. 
- Statistical test: use bootstrap CI on the delta for the primary metric and require the lower bound of the 95% CI > -0.25% to count as "no-regression"; for positive uplift we want lower bound > +0.5%.
- I'll add a small synthetic adversarial set to stress safety markers; if we see >2 safety failures /1000 we flag for manual stop.

Deliverables: sample bundle + pre-run report by Thu EOD. Can run the dry run with Karthik/Dev on Fri morning.
— Rishi
Research Engineer, Quality & Evals | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Quick summary and next steps: 
- Owners locked: Marissa (product sign-off), Rishi (evals & human review), Karthik + Dev (platform canary + alerts).
- Thresholds: product/regression thresholds per Marissa; infra rollback triggers per Karthik; research statistical bounds per Rishi.
- Deliverables due:
  * Rishi: sample bundle + pre-run report — Thu 2026-06-24 EOD (received).
  * Karthik/Dev: dry-run and canary infra config — Fri 2026-06-26 AM.
  * Marissa/Priya: final acceptance sign-off meeting — Fri 2026-06-26 2pm PT (invite sent).

As an immediate request to Atlas: Alicia — please confirm you are comfortable with the 5% canary + the rollback triggers above so procurement can finalize the SLA addendum. If Atlas needs a different canary cadence we can discuss in the call.

I'll create the #atlas-canary channel and a short runbook with the rollback steps and post the Doc link here when ready.

Thanks —
Priya
Product Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
